Hello I've scrolled through over 40 posts and see everything is quite Western focused. Looking for more authentic Thai Street food and open restaurant recommendations. Places similar to what you would find in abundance in BKK or Chiang Mai. Duck noodle soup, Moo Jum, Pad Krapow, great meals for 50 to 100 baht for the more adventurous. Not sure if can justify 280 baht for a bowl of Massaman curry when I'm accustomed to getting it for much less everywhere else in this country. Not a criticism btw. I do eat in the western restaurants here a lot. Just like to mix it up as we are in Thailand after all. And I do like to support the locals. Thanks!! #huahinfoodies
